rates.description: Biosensor selection, assay design, imaging strategy, quantitative analysis planning, and troubleshooting.

Quantitative evaluation of existing or prototype sensors in vitro or in cells. Measurements are selected according to the sensor and intended application and may include response magnitude, kinetics, apparent affinity or specificity, brightness, photostability, pH dependence, expression, or subcellular localization.
Experimental imaging, development of appropriate acquisition workflows, and quantitative analysis of biosensor data, including custom analysis when needed.
Practical guidance in biosensor implementation, imaging, experimental controls, and quantitative analysis.
Design, construction, and initial evaluation of new biosensor concepts when suitable existing tools are unavailable.
Larger collaborative projects involving sensor optimization, directed evolution, assay development, or other substantial biosensor-engineering work. Scope and cost are established individually.
